★★★ THE `.cfi_*` FAMILY, READ FROM A REAL `.s` AND NOW **HONOURED** — D-ASM-CFI-UNWIND-INFO-SILENTLY-DROPPED. ✔MEASURED 2026-08-13 with `gcc -O1 -fno-ident -fcf-protection=none -S` on a five-line C function: SIX `.cfi_*` lines against FIVE instructions, because `-fasynchronous-unwind-tables` is ON BY DEFAULT on every Linux target. Until 2026-08-17 this dialect ACCEPTED AND DROPPED every one of them, so the binary below ran correctly and could not be unwound. It now carries a real `.eh_frame` + `.eh_frame_hdr` built from these very lines.

★★★ WHAT MAKES IT A TEST RATHER THAN A PARSE DEMO, AND THE ANSWER CHANGED WITH THE FEATURE. Every declared spelling that states a HONOURED rule appears in `main.s`, so deleting any one row from `asm-x86_64-att.lang.json` turns this example red at `A0008` naming that spelling — the red-on-disable is per-ROW, not per-family. On top of that, the directives are INTERLEAVED with the computation (`100 − 7 = 93`, spilled to `32(%rsp)`, reloaded, `× 2 = 186`, then `helper(186, 144) = 42`) rather than bracketing it, so a directive that swallowed a following line, or a walker that resynchronized past one, changes the exit code instead of passing quietly. AND the arithmetic in the DIRECTIVES is now load-bearing too: `.cfi_rel_offset 6, 8` and `.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset 0` are folded against the running CFA offset, so a wrong fold changes the emitted table.

★★★ THE END-TO-END WITNESS, ✔MEASURED 2026-08-17 ON THE ELF THIS FILE PRODUCES: `readelf -S` finds `.eh_frame` and `.eh_frame_hdr`, `readelf --debug-dump=frames` reads back the SAME RULE SEQUENCE GNU as produces from the same source (the byte DELTAS differ because DSS encodes `subq $40,%rsp` in 7 bytes where gas uses 4 — which is exactly why every offset must be MEASURED rather than assumed), and **gdb 15.1 walks a 3-frame stack** helper → main → entry trampoline and stops, with frame 1's CFA exactly 48 bytes above frame 0's. ✔AND THE MATCHED CONTROL DISCRIMINATES: the identical file with every `.cfi_*` line deleted, same compiler, still exits 42 and `readelf -S` finds NO `.eh_frame` — gdb's walk then runs off into `0x7fffffffdf60 in ?? ()`, a STACK address presented as a return address. ⚠ BE PRECISE ABOUT WHERE IT DISCRIMINATES: gdb's own prologue heuristic happens to recover frame 1 even with no table, so a pin asserting merely 'two frames' would be satisfied by the control. The discrimination is at frame 2 and in the ABSENCE of the garbage frame.

★★★ ✔MEASURED AGAINST GNU as ITSELF, WHICH IS THE ONLY CHECK THAT SETTLES 'IS THIS REAL GAS': `as main.s -o main.o` returns rc=0. Per feedback_reference_compilers_are_the_spec that check is REQUIRED and it is bidirectional.

⛔⛔ WHY THERE IS NO pe64 ARM ANY MORE, AND IT IS A DECISION RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. Win64 `UNWIND_INFO` has a MANDATORY `SizeOfProlog` field and the GNU `.cfi_*` family has no verb that states where a prologue ends — ✔MEASURED 2026-08-17 over gcc 13.3.0's COMPLETE emitted spelling set on x86_64 and aarch64: nine spellings, none of them a prologue-end marker. So `pe.cpp` REFUSES this file by name (`K_UnwindRuleUnrepresentable`, quoting this very anchor) rather than inventing a number, and that refusal is PINNED in tests/asm/test_asm_cfi_producer.cpp so it can never quietly become a guess. An invented `SizeOfProlog` makes RtlVirtualUnwind classify body PCs as mid-prologue and rebuild a frame that is not there. ⚠ A derivation DOES look right on compiler output — 'the last CFA-growing rule' gets every gcc shape above correct — and is WRONG on hand-written code that allocates stack twice, which is precisely the code this tier exists for. The reference toolchain's own answer to Win64 unwind is the SEPARATE `.seh_*` directive family, whose `.seh_endprologue` IS the missing verb; adopting it is the named path forward. Five other `examples/asm/` fixtures keep the pe64 assembly path covered.

★ WHAT IS STILL UNDECLARED, AND STAYS FAIL-LOUD: `.cfi_personality`, `.cfi_lsda` and `.cfi_sections` are absent, because all three take a DOTTED SYMBOL operand (`DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0`, `.debug_frame`) that no `attOperand` arm can open. ✔MEASURED: `.cfi_sections .debug_frame` fails at `P0001 expected 'LineEnd' — got '.'`, i.e. at the grammar, not silently. Anchored under D-ASM-ATT-GAS-SURFACE-INCOMPLETE.

★ THE FRAME IS HAND-WRITTEN BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT THE `encode` TIER MEANS: `subq $40, %rsp` / `addq $40, %rsp` is the programmer's own prologue and epilogue, `materializeCallingConvention` does not run at this tier, and `32(%rsp)` sits above the 32-byte region Win64 reserves as shadow space. Only registers volatile under BOTH ABIs are touched (rax, rcx, rdx).

★ THE `release` ARM, SCOPED HONESTLY. At the `encode` tier no MIR module exists, so the optimizer, the register allocator and calling-convention materialization never run — this arm does NOT witness the optimizer and cannot. It pins the narrower fact that `--config=release` still produces a working, unwindable binary.

⚠⚠ AND THE HONEST LIMIT OF THIS EXAMPLE, STATED SO NOBODY READS MORE INTO ITS GREEN THAN IT CARRIES. ✔MEASURED 2026-08-17 by red-on-disable: with the PRODUCER removed from the emit walk (one deleted call, mutant M1) this example STAYS GREEN — the program still exits 42, because a dropped unwind table changes nothing observable at runtime. That is the row's whole thesis and it applies to its own witness. What this file DOES guard per-ROW is the CONFIG: deleting a `.cfi_*` row from the dialect makes the directive unknown and reds it at `A0008`. The PRODUCER is guarded by tests/asm/test_asm_cfi_producer.cpp, whose DWARF-byte pin reds on that same mutant.
